## Activity

This report covers activity at Market Eye Clinic for June 2025. The clinic team completed 421 captures during the month. The recorded activity provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures set out below. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. No further operational exception is recorded in the available summary.

## Image quality

Graders marked 83 sets ungradable. This represented an ungradable rate of 19.7 per cent of captures. The result is reported against the total of 421 captures and should be considered alongside the grading outcome. The image-quality measure identifies the captures that could not proceed through grading on the available images.

## Grading

A total of 95 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 2 days. This provides the central measure of the time between capture and completion of grading for the month. Together, the activity, image-quality and grading figures summarise service delivery at Market Eye Clinic in June 2025.
